messages:
julia_support: Escalation: Rivercrest trial provisioning failing during onboarding. Embeds return 403 for new API keys. Renewal window in ~6 weeks, usage ramping. Ticket SUP-129001 opened. Flagging for CS triage.

ops-bot: Alert: 7 provisioning failures for tenant rivercrest-test in 12h. Error pattern: 403 token_invalid. https://redwood.inc/alerts/SUP-129001

ana_cs: Thanks Julia. I'll coordinate customer comms. Can eng confirm whether this is a platform regression or a tenant config issue? Also need a short list of impacted endpoints and ETA for a mitigation.

julia_support: Quick repro attached (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inc/v1/tenants/rivercrest-test/embeds" -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***' -d '{"input":"test"}'

Response:
{
  "status": 403,
  "error": "token_invalid",
  "request_id": "req_0a1b2c"
}
```
SE tried manual rotate; customer says rotation job still sees 403s.

omar_eng: We shipped a change to the key validation cache yesterday that might affect short-lived tokens. Rolling a quick check now. If it's our cache TTL, workaround is to force immediate cache invalidation for the tenant.

devin_se: I can run cache invalidate for rivercrest-test and coordinate a test window. Ana, can you ask the customer for a 20-min window tomorrow 11:30am ET and request they pause their auto-rotate during the repro? Will need a quick ephemeral token upload via our secure form.

paul_ae: FYI I'll join the call and let the AE know renewal is on the line. Please include a simple, non-technical note we can send to the customer.

ana_cs: Draft message suggestion for Rivercrest:
"Hi Rivercrest team — We're seeing intermittent provisioning failures tied to API key validation. We're prioritizing this and have a troubleshooting session scheduled for tomorrow at 11:30am ET. As a temporary measure, please pause automatic key rotation and, if possible, upload a short-lived token via the secure form so our engineers can run a live test. We'll follow up within 24 hours with a remediation plan. Contact ops@redwood.com for urgent help."

julia_support: Good. Add the ticket link and mention SUP-129001. Also include the specific endpoints: POST /v1/tenants/:tenant/embeds and POST /v1/tenants/:tenant/provision.

omar_eng: Update: cache TTL looks fine for stable tokens, but there's an edge case when a rotation job issues tokens with zero-second validity due to clock skew. Working with infra to push a hotfix in the next 3 hours.

devin_se: I'll schedule the repro window and prepare the secure upload link. Ana — once we have the token, I can run a live test and report back within the call.

ana_cs: Owners assigned: Julia = support comms, Devin = SE lead (repro + secure token), Omar = eng owner (hotfix), Paul = AE/renewal notifier. I'll update SUP-129001 with the comms draft and calendar invite.

paul_ae: Noted. I'll prepare a one-paragraph renewal note for sales (impact, mitigation, timeline) once we have engineering confirmation.

ops-bot: Incident record created: INCIDENT-20260321-11. Escalation level: CS-P1. Runbook: onboarding-provisioning.

ana_cs: Thanks team — I'll send the customer note now and loop back after the repro. :white_check_mark:
